main_text.l: tus Calviniani, statim atque hoc opus
ut aliqvid certi de scripturis haberent, re-
currere cogeret, ita ut Libri censura Ca-
pello gratissima futura sit, simulqve oc-
casio cum suis in gratiam redeundi ; fu-
sius in hac Epistola Morinus Capellum
utilitatis ex hoc opere in Ecclesiam Ca-
vir Catholicus non reticuisset, verùm ni-
hil omnino in hoc opere critico extare,
qvod Religioni Catholicæ sit aperte con-
secum hujus libri editioni favisse. Addit

page.notes: The "t" of "ut" in line 4 is printed as a raised superscript; transcribed as ut. Long s is printed as s throughout and has been normalised to s. Line-end hyphens are kept. The text ends on "Ca-", and "Catholi-" at the lower right is the catchword. Ink marks at the left edge and right margin are not text.
